description: KL-53 is the Sub Regional Transport Office (SRTO) serving Perinthalmanna in the Malappuram district of Kerala. It is an administrative unit under the Regional Transport Office of Malappuram (KL-10) responsible for vehicle registrations and driver licensing in the region.
address: Padippura Buildings, Kozhikode - Palakkad Bypass Road, Perinthalmanna, Malappuram, Kerala
